$source = "C:\Apache24\htdocs\DEMO\uatmoon\frontend\dist"
$destination = "C:\Apache24\htdocs\DEMO\uatmoon"
$backup = "C:\Apache24\htdocs\DEMO\uatmoon-backup-$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss)"

if (!(Test-Path "$source\index.html")) {
    throw "Build output not found. Check the source path."
}

if (Test-Path $destination) {
    Copy-Item $destination $backup -Recurse
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null
robocopy $source $destination /E
